PROBE_SIGNALS.description: The signal a child died of, as the step and the crash block name it.

oneOf.title: sigsegv
oneOf.description: The child touched memory it may not.
oneOf.x-text: The child touched memory it may not.

oneOf.title: sigabrt
oneOf.description: The child called abort, or a runtime check failed.
oneOf.x-text: The child called abort, or a runtime check failed.

oneOf.title: sigbus
oneOf.description: The child made a bus error: a misaligned or unbacked access.
oneOf.x-text: The child made a bus error: a misaligned or unbacked access.

oneOf.title: sigfpe
oneOf.description: The child made an arithmetic fault.
oneOf.x-text: The child made an arithmetic fault.

oneOf.title: sigill
oneOf.description: The child ran an illegal instruction.
oneOf.x-text: The child ran an illegal instruction.

oneOf.title: sigkill
oneOf.description: The child was killed and could not catch it.
oneOf.x-text: The child was killed and could not catch it.

oneOf.title: sigterm
oneOf.description: The child was asked to end.
oneOf.x-text: The child was asked to end.

oneOf.title: sigxcpu
oneOf.description: The child passed its CPU-time limit.
oneOf.x-text: The child passed its CPU-time limit.

oneOf.title: sigxfsz
oneOf.description: The child wrote a file past the size limit.
oneOf.x-text: The child wrote a file past the size limit.

oneOf.title: sigsys
oneOf.description: The child made a syscall on the kill list.
oneOf.x-text: The child made a syscall on the kill list.

oneOf.title: sigpipe
oneOf.description: The child wrote to a pipe nobody reads.
oneOf.x-text: The child wrote to a pipe nobody reads.

oneOf.title: sigint
oneOf.description: The child was interrupted.
oneOf.x-text: The child was interrupted.

oneOf.title: sighup
